title: 700+ free web assets. people always ask the same question...
author: BuffaloConscious7919
selftext:
>What can i build?

usually i answer with a list e.g. websites, slidedecks, games, prototypes... basically anything digital!  
  
but i got me thinking . why not show instead of tell?!   
  
so i rolled up my proverbial sleeves, got brainstorming, planning and building a game that would change the WORLD (jks)  
  
anyway, after Claude and Codex helped me iterate of around 5 rounds (because we know one-shots will only get us so far , no matter what yt or tiktok says) it built something interesting... and more importantly it used the components for basically everything!

here's a few of the top features:

* no-login, signup and completely FREE to play
* mobile + desktop
* the game is comprised almost entirely of components. 75 web assets that came from my site and were used in unexpected ways. e.g. sometimes the full component was used othertimes just the animation or a particular state was used.
* levels are generative, there are different templates that rotate so you'll likely get different levels, components and enemies as you play though the game multiple times
* animations, powerups, shards and upgrades make the game kinda fun
* no-login leaderboard for all the 4 difficulty setting (try BRUTAL if you dare) 

it's by no means compete, nor is it the BEST GAME IN THE WORLD!!! but it is proof that we can build more and more interesting things in more and more interesting ways

as always i'm very open for feedback on the game, the library or anything else.

forevercomponents x 

ps. don't get too lost ;)

  
link: [https://forever-rift.vercel.app/](https://forever-rift.vercel.app/)
